# M1 compatibility fixture provenance

`m1-setup.ts` is frozen from `src/setup.ts` at
`bfbca214ae60a9c9ee6e66c30e27df7e77176270`. Only module/vendor import paths were
adjusted for this fixture location. It deliberately does not import M2 setup code.

The compatibility suite generates genuine M1 manifests and resources on each CI
host, validates them with M2, changes routes, and tests deinitialization/recovery.
Captured absolute paths are temporary fixture paths rather than checked-in machine
paths. Windows emits exe/shim pairs; Ubuntu/macOS emit shell launchers. Both harness
ownership flags, custom/mixed-case names, reordered JSON, edited configuration and
partial uninstall checkpoints are tested. A parser-accepted empty manifest remains
eligible for safe legacy removal but is not a healthy routing installation.
